headline: Goblin Shark crash fix, crafting quality table rewrite, item name unification, mistranslation fixes
summary: v2.5 is a stability + content release built on top of v2.4.2. Two player-reported crashes are fixed, the crafting quality description table was completely rewritten to fit within the engine's 12-character buffer limit, five crafted item names were unified to a single canonical name each, and several dialog and label corrections landed.

shipFormats.label: Released patch
shipFormats.description: Same patch format as v2.4.2: one xdelta3 patch per ROM revision; both produce the same patched ROM byte-for-byte.

shipNote: v2.5 ships one patch per ROM revision. Both behave identically — pick the one that matches your ROM's MD5.

otherChanges.title: Goblin Shark donation crash fixed — bubble text overflow (step-375)
otherChanges.body: Donating the Goblin Shark to the fish encyclopedia triggered a food-critic verdict bubble (msg99062 entry 76) whose second page was 38 visible characters — 6 over the 32-char bubble cap. On real hardware this caused an instant crash; emulators showed screen glitches. Before: 'Oh, this is wonderful! I've never▼tasted anything this delicious before!§' (page 2: 38 chars). After: 'Oh, this is wonderful!▼So utterly delicious!§' (page 1: 22 chars, page 2: 21 chars). The Japanese source is the single exclamation おぉ すばらしい！§ — the prior English had imported a second sentence from the parallel window-path sibling at msg32086, which was unnecessary and caused the overflow. Fixes bug report #9 from Zeno against v2.3.2.

otherChanges.title: Crafting quality table rewrite — msg99047 buffer overflow fix (step-376)
otherChanges.body:
Using certain crafted items (e.g. the Prank Quill) triggered a crash on real hardware. The root cause: msg99047 is a crafting-quality description lookup table where each entry contains 12 NUL-separated segments (one per quality tier). The game reads each segment into a fixed-size buffer. The JP source never exceeds 12 characters per segment across all 468 segments — but 144 of the English segments were over that limit, some reaching 35 characters. 24 entries were rewritten. Fixes bug report #10 from Zeno against v2.4.2. Note: this surface's 12-character-per-segment cap was derived empirically from the JP source data, not from engine bytecode. If you see clipped or broken text in crafting-quality descriptions, please report it via the bug-report form. Per-entry changes follow.

Entries 0–2, 15–16 (placeholder delimiters): the DB had collapsed 12 separate ………§ segments into one long blob of 24 ellipsis chars. Restored the proper 12-segment delimiter structure matching the JP source. Entry 27 (single-ellipsis placeholder): same fix, with single ellipsis … per segment.

Entry 4 (quality adjective): 'pretty' capitalized to 'Pretty' across all 12 segments for consistency. Entries 3, 5, 6 (Normal, Dazzling, Mysterious) were already within the cap and unchanged.

Entry 7 (radiance/shine descriptors, all 12 segments over cap): 'a kingly radiance' (17 chars) → 'Kingly Glow' (11), 'a sparkly-bright shine' (22) → 'Flashy Glow' (11), 'a mysteriously eerie glow' (25) → 'Eerie Glow' (10), 'an incredibly intense shine' (27) → 'Fierce Glow' (11), 'a galactic shimmer' (18) → 'Cosmic Glow' (11), 'a dizzying brilliance' (21) → 'Dizzy Glow' (10), 'a starlike twinkle' (18) → 'Starry Glow' (11), 'a gorgeous gleam' (16) → 'Lavish Glow' (11), 'a noble queen's light' (21) → 'Regal Light' (11), 'the ultimate radiance' (21) → 'Supreme Glow' (12), 'a self-illuminating glow' (24) → 'Inner Glow' (10), 'a dazzling brilliance' (21) → 'Bright Glow' (11).

otherChanges.title: Mistranslation fix: ねいろ (tone/timbre) corrected from 'color' — msg99047 entry 17 (step-376)
otherChanges.body: Entry 17 of the crafting quality table (tone descriptors) had been entirely mistranslated. The JP ねいろ means 'tone' or 'timbre' (musical quality), not 'color'. All 12 segments were wrong. Before → after: 'A color that makes your heart skip' → 'Joyful Tone', 'A color that makes you want to play' → 'Playful Tone', 'A color that can deceive people' → 'Tricky Tone', 'A color that makes you want to sing' → 'Singable', 'A pleasant sound' → 'Pleasing Ear', 'An enchanting color' → 'Dreamy Tone', 'A color that makes your heart dance' → 'Lively Tone', 'A calming color' → 'Calming Tone', 'A color you can lose yourself in' → 'Absorbing', 'An enchanting color' → 'Lovely Tone', 'A color that seeps in smoothly' → 'Soothing', 'A reassuring color' → 'Relaxing'.

otherChanges.title: Item name unification — five crafted items standardized (steps 377, 380, 381)
otherChanges.body:
Five crafted item names had inconsistent English translations scattered across dialog files, classroom lessons, recipe labels, lookup tables, the Part-Time Cat crafting lines, and the ucc_names crafting-product table. Each was unified to one canonical name. Every individual change is listed below.

Prank Quill (JP イタズラはねペン — literal meaning 'Prank Feather Pen'; 'Quill' captures the feather concept). Not present in Game 1. 11 entries updated across 6 files: msg52065 entry 0 'study the [COLOR:4]Prank Pen[COLOR:1]' → 'study the [COLOR:4]Prank Quill[COLOR:1]'; entry 1 'Prank Pen recipe' → 'Prank Quill recipe' (2 occurrences in textblock); entry 2 'pick the Prank Pen recipe' → 'pick the Prank Quill recipe'; entry 11 'draw with a Prank Pen' → 'draw with a Prank Quill'; entry 13 'use the Prank Pen' → 'use the Prank Quill'; entry 17 'Learned how to make a Prank Pen' → 'Learned how to make a Prank Quill'; msg99026 entry 10 'Prank Pen§' → 'Prank Quill§'; msg99037 entry 25 'Prank Pen§' → 'Prank Quill§'; msg32108 entry 49 '[COLOR:4]Prank Feather Pen[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Prank Quill[COLOR:1]'; msg32110 entry 80 '[COLOR:4]Prankster Pen[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Prank Quill[COLOR:1]'; msg99138 entry 27 'Pranks, pens, and such§' → 'Prank Quill, etc.§'.

Lure Bouquet (JP おさそいブーケ — 'enticement/invitation bouquet'). 12 entries + 1 ucc_names slot updated across 6 files: msg32108 entry 68 '[COLOR:4]Invitation Bouquet[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Lure Bouquet[COLOR:1]'; msg52063 entry 20 '[COLOR:4]Invitation Bouquet[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Lure Bouquet[COLOR:1]'; entry 21 'from an Invitation Bouquet recipe' → 'from a Lure Bouquet recipe' (grammar corrected); entry 22 'pick the Invitation Bouquet recipe' → 'pick the Lure Bouquet recipe'; entry 31 'the Invitation Bouquet have' → 'the Lure Bouquet have'; entry 37 'Learned how to make an Invitation Bouquet' → 'Learned how to make a Lure Bouquet' (grammar corrected); msg99026 entry 3 'Invitation Bouquet§' → 'Lure Bouquet§'; msg99037 entry 10 'Invitation Bouquet§' → 'Lure Bouquet§'; msg99138 entry 23 'Invitation Bouquet, etc.§' → 'Lure Bouquet, etc.§'; ucc_names slot 50 'Date Bouquet' → 'Lure Bouquet'.

Charm Aroma (JP みわくのかおり — 'charm/enchanting fragrance'). 11 entries updated across 5 files: msg52066 entry 80 '[COLOR:4]Enchanting Aroma[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Charm Aroma[COLOR:1]'; entry 81 'Enchanting Aroma recipe' → 'Charm Aroma recipe' (2 occurrences); entry 82 'pick the Enchanting Aroma recipe' → 'pick the Charm Aroma recipe'; entry 91 'does Enchanting Aroma have' → 'does Charm Aroma have'; entry 93 'Enchanting Aroma attracts people' → 'Charm Aroma attracts people'; entry 97 'Learned how to make Enchanting Aroma' → 'Learned how to make Charm Aroma'; msg32108 entry 67 '[COLOR:4]Alluring Scent[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Charm Aroma[COLOR:1]'; msg99026 entry 5 'Alluring Scent§' → 'Charm Aroma§'; entry 15 '★Alluring Aroma§' → '★Charm Aroma§'; msg99037 entry 29 'Alluring Scent§' → 'Charm Aroma§'; msg99138 entry 24 'Enchanting Scent, etc.§' → 'Charm Aroma, etc.§'.

Sereni-Tea (JP やすらぎティー — 'peace/serenity tea'; preserves the tea pun). 9 entries + 1 ucc_names slot updated across 5 files: msg52064 entry 80 '[COLOR:4]Tranquility Tea[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Sereni-Tea[COLOR:1]'; entry 81 'Tranquility Tea recipe' / 'make Tranquility Tea' → 'Sereni-Tea recipe' / 'make Sereni-Tea'; entry 82 'Tranquility Tea recipe' → 'Sereni-Tea recipe'; entry 97 'Learned how to make Tranquility Tea' → 'Learned how to make Sereni-Tea'; msg32108 entry 66 '[COLOR:4]Relaxation Tea[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Sereni-Tea[COLOR:1]'; msg99026 entry 4 'Tranquili-Tea§' → 'Sereni-Tea§'; msg99037 entry 20 'Tranquili-Tea§' → 'Sereni-Tea§'; msg99138 entry 25 'Relaxation Tea, etc.§' → 'Sereni-Tea, etc.§'; ucc_names slot 51 'Calming Tea' → 'Sereni-Tea'.

Chic Clothes (JP イケてるふく — 'cool/stylish clothes'). Product-name occurrences updated; generic dialog uses of 'stylish clothes' or 'cool clothes' left unchanged. 6 entries updated across 4 files: msg33037 entry 52 'Stylish clothes!▼S-T-Y-L-I-S-H!§' → 'Chic Clothes!▼C-H-I-C!§'; msg32108 entry 48 '[COLOR:4]cool clothes[COLOR:1]' → '[COLOR:4]Chic Clothes[COLOR:1]'; msg99026 entry 6 'Stylish clothes§' → 'Chic Clothes§'; msg99037 entry 9 'Cool clothes§' → 'Chic Clothes§'; msg99138 entry 26 'Trendy clothes, etc.§' → 'Chic Clothes, etc.§'.

otherChanges.title: Magic-input NPC label 'Shammy' corrected to 'Jamie' (steps 361, 380)
otherChanges.body: The magic-input panel at inputmagic/msg.ofs entry 637 displayed 'Shammy' for npc_id 1137 (JP シャミー), inconsistent with the rest of the game where she appears as 'Jamie'. The NPC-name binary already read 'Jamie'; the magic-input label was the outlier. Two source tables feed this surface: the entries table (row for inputmagic/msg.ofs entry 637, sub_entry 0) and the magic_glyphs table (slot 637). Step-361 fixed the entries table row from 'Shammy' to 'Jamie'. Step-380 fixed the magic_glyphs slot from 'Shammy' to 'Jamie' — this is the table the magic-input OFS rebuild actually reads from.

otherChanges.title: Shop name 'Very's' corrected to 'Berry's' — three dialog rows (step-361)
otherChanges.body: The in-game shop name ベリーズ ('Berry's') had been mistranslated as 'Very's' in three dialog rows. Before → after: msg40086 entry 30 sub 0 'Really?▼It wasn't featured in▼[COLOR:4]Very's[COLOR:1]?§' → 'Really?▼It wasn't featured in▼[COLOR:4]Berry's[COLOR:1]?§'; msg44086 entry 13 sub 0 'it's different from the one▼in [COLOR:4]Very's[COLOR:1]…' → 'it's different from the one▼in [COLOR:4]Berry's[COLOR:1]…'; msg47086 entry 32 sub 1 'Is this the outfit from▼[COLOR:4]Very's[COLOR:1]?§' → 'Is this the outfit from▼[COLOR:4]Berry's[COLOR:1]?§'.

otherChanges.title: Malila part-time payment text — missing ritch amount restored (step-362)
otherChanges.body: After completing a part-time job for Granny Malila, her payment-confirmation dialog read 'This is your payment! Ritch. Keep it safe, okay?' — the 100 ritch amount was missing from the line. Before: 'This is your payment!▼[SFX_TRIGGER:536][SFX_VALUE:100] Ritch.▼Keep it safe, okay?§'. After: 'This is your payment!▼[SFX_TRIGGER:536][SFX_VALUE:100]100 Ritch.▼Keep it safe, okay?§'. The literal '100' had been dropped from this one row during the original translation pass. The game-side transfer of ritch into the player's wallet was unaffected; only the spoken confirmation text was wrong. Fixes bug report #8 from pandabearcare against v2.4.2.

otherChanges.title: Fungi Forest habitat dropdown label restored (step-363)
otherChanges.body: The habitat-filter dropdown in the catalog/journal UI had the Fungi Forest row translated as a full sentence instead of the short label the JP source specifies. Before: 'I took a packed lunch and went out to spend the day in Fungi Forest.' (69 chars, a sentence that does not belong in a dropdown). After: 'Fungi Forest§' (short label matching the JP source キノコの森 and the two other habitat labels in the same dropdown, Lonely Island and Dorm).
